tagline: Preview PDFs, images, videos, audio, and text files inside Odoo without downloading
problem: Users must download attachments to see what is inside invoices, products, and documents.
solution: Preview supported files directly in Odoo with thumbnails, hover preview, and a full-screen gallery viewer.
benefits: Instant PDF and image preview in forms
Thumbnail strip instead of filename-only attachments

features.title: PDF Preview
features.text: Open PDFs in the built-in viewer with zoom and page scroll.

features.title: Image Gallery
features.text: Preview PNG, JPG, SVG, GIF, and WEBP with next/previous navigation.

features.title: Video and Audio
features.text: Play MP4, WEBM, MP3, WAV, and OGG files inline.

features.title: Text Files
features.text: Read TXT, CSV, JSON, and XML without leaving Odoo.

features.title: Thumbnail Strip
features.text: Visual attachment cards with Preview and Download actions.

workflow: See visual thumbnails on the attachment strip
Navigate across files like a gallery

faq.q: Which file types are supported in V1?
faq.a: PDF, images, video, audio, and text files such as TXT, CSV, JSON, and XML.

faq.q: Does it support Excel or Word?
faq.a: Not in V1. Office previews are planned once a reliable browser preview engine is integrated.
Yes. Users can only preview attachments they are allowed to read in Odoo.

seo_keywords: Odoo 19 attachment preview, PDF preview Odoo, file viewer Odoo, document preview without download
